title: Project sessions' full replies and questions come back to the Assistant

requirements.text: When a project session finishes a turn, its full final reply reaches the Assistant labelled with project and session, whether or not voice is on
requirements.check: cd app && swift test (relay case) + eye: tell a project something, its reply appears in the Assistant

requirements.text: A question a project agent asks the user (genlock ask user) reaches the Assistant, and the Assistant's answer goes back with genlock answer
Replies are not delivered twice, and the Assistant is not interrupted mid-turn: they queue until it is idle
assistantRule tells the Assistant these are agent reports, to relay them to the user and pass answers back with genlock tell
swift build, swift test and node tests/run.mjs pass
requirements.check: cd app && swift build && swift test; node tests/run.mjs

text: Found: today only voice summaries (channel say-*.json, takeMessages) reach the Assistant, via routeUpdates (AppModel ~L887), only with voice on and 2+ projects ready. Full replies need a new path: transcript last assistant message, or a hook writing it. Outbound already exists: genlock tell PROJECT --session (lib/overview.mjs cmdTell). Not started.
Only sessions the Assistant told something (genlock tell) send their final replies back; questions for the user always do
breaks: If TJ wants every turn of every session relayed, sessions he works in directly would not report; widen by dropping the awaiting-reply check in lib/voice.mjs

evidence: tests/run.mjs pass: 'a question for the user reaches the Assistant too, with its id' (relay kind=question, question=Q-id, text), '...but not one the Assistant asks itself', 'the answer goes back with genlock answer'; briefing tells the Assistant to use genlock at PROJECT answer Q-ID (swift testRelayBriefingLabelsEachReportOnOneLine)

tests/run.mjs: '...once: the session no longer owes a reply', '...so a later turn is not sent again'; swift testRelaysWaitForAnIdleAssistantAndEveryReply (not while Assistant working/waiting/dictating; holds while a told session still works, up to 600s) and testRelaysAreReadFromTheChannelAndRuleIsGiven (peek leaves files, removed after delivery) pass

Voice.swift assistantRule: 'Replies come back to you: after genlock tell, that session's whole reply arrives as a [relay] message ... pass the user's answers back with genlock tell TASK'; asserted by testRelaysAreReadFromTheChannelAndRuleIsGiven
swift build: Build complete; swift test: 124 tests, 0 failures; node tests/run.mjs: 494 passed, 0 failed

text: Built: tell marks awaiting-reply; Stop hook writes the full last_assistant_message as relay-*.json (cut at 6000), Notification waits too; ask user writes a question relay. AppModel.relayToAssistant delivers all as one [relay] line when the Assistant is idle and no told session is still working (600s cap). Reqs 2-5 proved; req 1 needs relaunch + eye. Not committed.

evidence: TJ waived the eye check: 'im just going to trust you ;) consider it'. Hook writes the full reply (tests/run.mjs) and the app's routing/briefing is unit-tested; end-to-end in the live app unobserved.
